subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

DILEMMA
solution:
The correct answer is- 'quandary'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's understand the meaning of the given word:
 
• The word dilemma is a noun and it means *a situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two different things. *(ऐसी स्थिति जिसमें दो अलग-अलग चीजों के बीच एक कठिन चुनाव करना पड़ता है।)
 
 
• Example: *She faces the **dilemma **of disobeying her father or losing the man she loves.*

 
 
 
 
• By this meaning, we can say that 'quandary' is a similar word to 'dilemma.'

Thus *option 3 *is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The antonyms of the given word is:

 
 
• solution
 
 
 
• The meaning of the given options is:
 
 
• quandary - State of uncertainty or perplexity especially as requiring a choice between equally unfavourable options (अनिश्चितता या उलझन की स्थिति विशेष रूप से समान रूप से प्रतिकूल विकल्पों के बीच)
 
• advantage - Having a superior or more favourable position (श्रेष्ठ या अधिक अनुकूल स्थिति होना)
 
• success - A state of prosperity (समृद्धि की स्थिति)
 
• solution - A method for solving a problem (किसी समस्या को हल करने का एक तरीका)
